items.description: Edit an Admin-type task's VisitLog: no Metrics section is shown, and submitting saves cleanly (redirect, no error).
items.expected_result: No 'Metrics & Collection' section; submit redirects and saves.

items.description: On the admin log edit, set hidden metrics-TOTAL_FORMS to 2 in DevTools and submit.
items.expected_result: Save succeeds (redirect), no error banner, no phantom metrics created.

items.description: On a Litter Run log edit, add a photo with a description shorter than 10 chars and submit.
items.expected_result: Page reloads with red banner 'Please correct the errors below' listing the photo description error.

items.description: Clear the Date field and submit; then enter a negative participant count and submit.
items.expected_result: Banner lists 'Date' and a red inline error appears under Date; inline error appears under the participant input.

items.description: Section → Create, leave Name blank, submit.
items.expected_result: Red banner at top listing Name error + inline error under the field.

items.description: Create a non-rolling Task with no date, submit.
items.expected_result: Banner lists 'Date' error ('Date is required for non-rolling tasks.') + inline error.

items.description: Create a Task Template and a Task Type with blank names/codes, submit each.
items.expected_result: Banner + inline errors appear on both forms.

items.description: Complete and re-open a task; then save a valid visit log edit.
items.expected_result: Success toasts still appear; no error banner when valid.
